meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 当你让它做 git 操作时，它会先判断你想提交代码、整理提交记录还是查找历史；如果是提交，它会自动把改动按目录和逻辑拆成多个小提交，并沿用仓库现有的提交风格；它还会帮你压缩提交、找出某行代码是谁写的或何时加的。
howto.when: 当你提到 commit、rebase、who wrote 等关键词，或用任何语言表达提交、变基、查找历史时，它会接管处理。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成多个小提交。
say.note: 先分析改动，再按模块生成多个提交。

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个。
say.note: 会执行 rebase 压缩提交。

say.text: 这行代码是什么时候加的？
say.note: 用 git blame 或 log 查找历史。

howto.what_en: Detects commit/rebase/history requests. For commits, splits changes into multiple atomic commits following repo style; also handles rebase/squash and traces when/who added code.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like 'commit', 'rebase', 'who wrote' or express intent to commit, rebase, or search history.

say_en.text: Split these changes into multiple small commits.
say_en.note: It analyzes the changes and creates separate commits by module.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: Runs an interactive rebase to combine them.
Uses git blame or log to find the history.
